Roofing & Exterior Services

Everything above your walls — and the gutters and siding that carry water away from them. Free inspection and written estimate on all of it.

At a glance

Roughneck Roofing provides 7 exterior services in Pittsburgh, PA: roof replacement, roof repair, storm damage & insurance claims, roof inspections, gutters & downspouts, siding & exteriors, commercial roofing. Inspections and written estimates are free on all of them, and every job is photo-documented from start to finish.

Roof Replacement

Full tear-off and rebuild with architectural shingles, new underlayment, ice-and-water shield, and a properly balanced ventilation system.

Most homes: $9,000 - $22,000 Learn more

Roof Repair

Fast, honest leak diagnosis and lasting repairs - flashing, valleys, boots, and storm damage. If a repair will hold, we repair it.

Most repairs: $350 - $1,800 Learn more

Storm Damage & Insurance Claims

Wind and hail damage inspection, documentation your adjuster can actually use, and a contractor who meets them on the roof.

Inspection: free · You pay your deductible Learn more

Roof Inspections

A real inspection - on the roof and in the attic - with photos of everything we find and a straight answer about remaining service life.

Free · Certification reports available Learn more

Gutters & Downspouts

Seamless aluminum gutters sized and pitched correctly, plus guards that actually keep debris out without starving the system.

Typical home: $1,400 - $4,500 Learn more

Siding & Exteriors

Vinyl and fiber cement siding, plus the soffit, fascia, and trim work that keeps the whole envelope tight.

Typical home: $9,000 - $28,000 Learn more

Commercial Roofing

TPO, EPDM, and modified bitumen for flat and low-slope buildings - plus maintenance programs that catch problems before tenants do.

Quoted per square foot Learn more
The standard

What every Roughneck job includes

Photo documentation

Dated pictures of the roof and attic before we start and after we finish. You keep them.

Written scope

Line-item estimate with materials, quantities, and unit prices for anything discovered mid-job.

Licensed & insured

General liability and workers compensation. Certificates on request, before work starts.

Double magnetic sweep

Lawn, driveway, and street swept twice. Find a nail later and we come back out.

Not sure which service you need?

That is what a free inspection is for. We will look, photograph, and tell you honestly — including when the answer is "nothing yet."
